name: Hall of the Brave
summary: Warriors train and gather at the Hall of the Brave in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. The barracks and guild house serves the Horde's front-line combatants, drillmasters, and battlemasters.

sections.title: The Warriors' Bastion
sections.body: The Hall of the Brave overlooks the Valley of Honor's waters and training rings. Veteran officers and seasoned warriors teach initiates melee combat, stances, and discipline. Training dummies and weapons line the hall, where battlemasters organize combatants for major military engagements across Azeroth.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Hall of the Brave?
aliases: what is hall of the brave
faq.answer: The Hall of the Brave is Orgrimmar's main barracks and guild hall for warriors. Veteran trainers teach techniques, practice dummies offer a place to hone strikes, and battlemasters coordinate military deployments across contested lands.

faq.q: Where in Orgrimmar is the hall located?
aliases: where is hall of the brave
faq.answer: The Hall of the Brave sits on the eastern side of the Valley of Honor, along the red canyon walls overlooking the central pond.

faq.q: Who can be found inside the hall?
aliases: who is in hall of the brave
faq.answer: Warrior trainers, battlemasters coordinating large military conflicts, and Horde grunts resting between patrols can be found inside the hall.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can train at the Hall of the Brave, your martial home in the capital. Its trainers teach advanced stances and battle maneuvers as your skill grows.
As a member of the Horde, you can see its frontline discipline at the Hall of the Brave. Battlemasters there muster troops to fight across the continent.
